highlights.title: ChatGPT plan limits in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models now shows a ChatGPT sign-in's limits as Codex last reported them, one meter per limit.

highlights.title: Claude's 5-hour limit in Settings
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models now shows a Claude account's 5-hour limit under its weekly one: how much is used and when it resets.

highlights.title: More permission choices as buttons
highlights.line: A Claude agent's permission question now shows every choice as a button. One that lasts, like "don't ask again", needs a second press.

highlights.title: Accounts on your other computers
highlights.line: Settings, AI Models opened from a computer's Kosmos+ address now also lists your other computers' Claude accounts and their agents.

highlights.title: Projects are optional
highlights.line: Taking an agent off its last project no longer puts a warning sign on it, and a new team's Project is optional.
